entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie... I hope you can help me. I need to return my new VeloBand GPS Tracker.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

Oh, no, the band itself is fine. It's beautiful. It's just... we can't use it now. My husband had a medical emergency right after I bought it for him. He needed unexpected surgery and we've been at the hospital for weeks.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope his recovery is going well.

Thank you. It's just been a lot. He's in the military, and this whole thing has completely disrupted his upcoming deployment schedule. Honestly, with all the medical bills, I really needed this money back. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, I was just hoping for some understanding.
I completely understand the situation, and I appreciate your loyalty to VeloFit. Let me just pull up your order details and check the policy for you. One moment.
Okay, I see the order here. It was delivered 19 days ago. Let me just confirm our return window... Yes, according to our policy, you have 90 days from the delivery date for a full refund.
Oh, 90 days? Really? I was so worried I had missed the deadline with everything going on.
Not at all, you are well within the timeframe. I can go ahead and process this return for a full refund for you right now. No problem at all.
That's... that's wonderful news. Thank you so much, Charlie. That's a huge weight off my shoulders. I really appreciate it.

You are very welcome. I'm happy I could help. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email on file. Just place the device back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at the post office. You'll see the refund in 3-5 business days after we receive it.
Perfect. Thank you again for being so helpful.
Of course. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Have a great day.
You too. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
